column1: # ZAP baseline rules for FindMyUni: only alerts that are known false positives or pure information are ignored; everything else stays a warning.
# Format: rule id <TAB> IGNORE|WARN|FAIL <TAB> (rule name). Lines starting with # are comments.
# 10027: "suspicious comments" matches words like "user", "admin", "TODO" inside the minified Next.js/React bundles, not our own comments.
# 10096: "timestamp disclosure" flags the long numbers in build hashes and bundled library code; the site shows no server times.
# 10109: purely informational note that the site is a modern JavaScript app (it suggests switching to the AJAX spider).
